metadata.question: From January to mid-May, did Jaén a few miles east of Córdoba recieve more than 3 inches of rain fall in 2023?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in Jaén (east of Córdoba, Spain) from January to mid-May 2023, specifically if it received more than 3 inches of rain. I need to: 1. Find precipitation data for this location and timeframe 2. Use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) which provides global precipitation data 3. Convert from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) 4. Sum the precipitation over the period 5. Compare to 3 inches (76.2 mm) Steps: - Define geometry for Jaén, Spain - Use CHIRPS collection: 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY' - Filter date range: 2023-01-01 to 2023-05-15 - Sum precipitation and convert to inches - Check data availability and valid pixels - Output result Let me structure this: 1. Define point geometry for Jaén, Spain (approx coordinates: 37.7796°N, 3.7849°W) 2. Get CHIRPS data for Jan 1 - May 15, 2023 3. Check collection size 4. Sum precipitation and check pixel count 5. Convert to inches and compare to 3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const jaen = ee.Geometry.Point([-3.7849, 37.7796]); // Jaén, Spain coordinates const buffer = jaen.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around Jaén const startDate = '2023-01-01'; const endDate = '2023-05-15'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS precipitation data const precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(buffer); // Check collection size const colSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images in period: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation const totalPrecip = precipCol.sum(); // Check pixel count const pixelCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean precipitation in mm, convert to inches const meanPrecip = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const precipInches = meanPrecip / 25.4; // Convert mm to inches console.log(`Total precipitation: ${meanPrecip.toFixed(1)} mm (${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches)`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (meanPrecip === null || isNaN(meanPrecip) || precipInches === null || isNaN(precipInches)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (precipInches > 3) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
